Name: Passable Crops
Author: ncarigon
Description:
This mod makes all crops allow farmers to pass through them, just like Junimo can. Additionally, newly-planted trellis crops will shake when a farmer walks through them.

It does not alter any other crop behavior, any crop properties, nor how crops interact with any other types of characters so it should be widely compatible with other mods.

While similar mods already exist, I found they were either outdated, generated errors, didn't work with modded crops, or had unexpected side-effects.

New in version 1.0.2:
[list]
[*]Farmers can pass through scarecrows, sprinklers, and/or forage items.[/*]
[*]Each object type is individually configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.0.3:
[list]
[*]Farmers can pass through tea bushes.[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.0.5:
[list]
[*]Farmers can pass through tree / fruit tree saplings.[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.0.7:
[list]
[*]Farmers can pass through weeds.[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.0.8:
[list]
[*]Farmers will slow down when passing through objects[/*]
[*]Added option to disable custom object drawing[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.1.0:
[list]
[*]Support for Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.1.1:
[list]

[/list]
New in version 1.1.5:
[list]

[/list]
New in version 1.1.6:
[list]
[*]Added config option to disable shaking of non-crop objects.[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.2.0:
[list]
[*]Added config option for custom include/exclude passable objects[/*]
[*]Added config option to allow passable fully grown trees[/*]
[/list]
New in version 1.2.2:
[list]
[*]Support for 118n.[/*]
[/list]New in version 1.3.0:
[list]
[*]Removed custom object draw code in favor of built-in object shaking, with significant logic rework.[/*]
[*]Added config option to support slowing down more when passing large objects.[/*]
[*]Increased default passable tree growth size from 3 to 4.[/*]
[/list]
The previous custom drawing logic has been removed so the potential incompatibilities should no longer exist. I've kept the wording here as a reference for any pre-1.3.0 versions.

[s]The logic required to walk through scarecrows, sprinklers, forage items, and weeds required overriding those object draw routines. This makes them less compatible with other mods that also override those routines, but I am not aware of any specific incompatibilities. The method used to do this was significantly reworked in version 1.1.1 and should have increased compatibility now.[/s]
